# DeepSeek Harness UI theme

`dsh-base.css` and `dsh-design-platform.css` are copied from the official
DeepSeek Harness repository at commit `46a7f68`:

- `packages/client/ui-theme/src/styles/base.css`
- `packages/client/ui-theme/src/styles/design-platform.css`

They are used by the local Rust Agent page. Their MIT license is included in
`LICENSE.deepseek-harness`.
